station_name: San Jacinto River near San Jacinto, Calif.
notes: Table 'Discharge measurements of San Jacinto River near San Jacinto, Calif., during the year ending September 30, 1925'. Dates are printed without year (Dec. 31 to July 7); years taken from the title's water year, so Dec. 31 = 1924. Used the printed first and last measurement dates rather than the whole water year because this is a list of discrete measurements. Count: 16 measurement dates (6 + 6 + 4 across the three column groups), each with a gage height and a discharge = 32. No station number, county or basin printed. Text above mentions Lake Hemet Water Co. storage on South Fork of San Jacinto River at Lake Hemet (regulation, not the site).
